title: Better Bucket
body:
Better Bucket









Better Bucket adds various tweaks to the original vanilla buckets. Here is a list that contain some of the features:



Lava buckets now have a stability timer (configurable)

Smoother placement and flow behavior

Improved liquid pickup for water and lava 




(WORKS WITH MODDED FLUIDS)



CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-bucket
